name: Quran Uthmani 6236-ayah corpus fixture
source_description: 6236-ayah Uthmani Quran dataset derived from Tanzil/QPC and independently validated by the upstream project
license: CC BY 4.0 for the upstream dataset; see upstream LICENSE/NOTICE. Tanzil source attribution applies upstream.
pinning: The downloaded bytes are pinned locally by SHA-256 in fixture.lock.json. The repo does not treat an un-fetched branch URL as a content hash.
reason_not_bundled: This build environment can verify the public source and metadata but cannot materialize the 4.74 MB remote file. Run tools/fetch_quran_fixture.py once in a networked checkout to create the exact local fixture and lock.
